Production singleton defaults to actual Unity input provider

Player disposal removes production touch callback while independent manager listeners keep receiving frames
Shutdown retains touch/key/scroll state and native singleton owner

Singleton resides in Unity persistent scene across active-scene switch
Destroyed native singleton recreates named owner with fresh source defaults
